facts.raw_span: 42-year-old Caucasian man
12-year history of well-controlled HIV
undetectable viral load, CD4+ count 1184 × 10^6 cell/liter
low-grade fever (37.5°)
sudden appearance of skin lesions at the base of his penis
vesicular and umbilicated lesions on genitals
fever up to 39°C
chest pain without irradiation
shortness of breath
High-sensitivity cardiac troponin: 128.00 pg/ml initially, peaked at 142.00 pg/ml
ECG: Showed sinus tachycardia with elevated PR segment in aVR lead and depressed in peripheral and thoracic leads
Echocardiography: Left ventricle diastolic diameter of 59 mm, hypokinetic left ventricle with EF 50%
